name: HAPPY 🔪
desc:
You get locked in a store at night and it seems like this AI cleaning robot was programmed to remove more than just trash... Can you escape Wobmart after dark?

✔️ SURVIVORS: Find the correct items around Wobmart & scan them to unlock the emergency exits and make your escape
💀 KILLERS: Prevent survivors from escaping by using your abilities and chasing them down!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a rare tradeable knife and +1 free respawn!
🤝 Play with friends for 10% more rewards!

Unlock unique killers, knife skins, and animations to personalize your gameplay
Make deals and trade your killers and knife skins with other players

Grocery store horror escape game
Sequel to Panik (panic but with a K)

⚠️ Exploiters get banned
